responsibility: This machine-description file provides the NDS32 floating-point RTL patterns. It covers scalar SF/DF moves, constant materialization, conditional moves, arithmetic, fused operations, conversions, comparisons, copysign/abs/negation, and register transfer interactions between general and floating registers, along with target-specific splits for unavailable direct moves or wide constants, making it the core FPU instruction-pattern description separate from the intrinsic-only unspec patterns.
